items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 5, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: he would say, “it’s nice to be here with Minnie, Mickey and Minnie Mouse”

ctx.x: Um hum. If I put Terry Gibbs and Jack Sheldon and Chubby Jackson in a room together, I wonder what might occur?

Well first you’d have to call the insane asylum. You call the insane asylum and make a reservation at the insane asylum. Because I don’t know it would be a lot of laughs. Talk about — Chubby and I had — a completely differently than Jack and I did. I’ll tell you about Jack. You know Jack could get a little risqué on stage. But when he worked with me he knew that he could not do that. I’m selling music and I’ll be the straight man, and Jack is funny without having to be dirty. You know he’s funny. He’s got a great…

Yes. So we’ve been at this for about an hour, I’ve really enjoyed this. I want to wrap up with a couple of questions. I wonder if you could have done anything else in your life besides being a musician.
